rdfs:label: hasValue
rdfs:comment: On an OWL Restriction, requires that the constrained property has a specific individual or literal among its values (other values are still allowed) — equivalent to `someValuesFrom` a one-element class.
notes: "On property X, one of the values is this." Use to define classes like "Things whose `acl:mode` includes `acl:Read`." Value can be any individual or literal. Equivalent to `someValuesFrom` the one-element class `{v}`; it does not forbid additional values (add `maxCardinality 1` for that).

examples.title: Authorizations that grant access to everyone (agentClass foaf:Agent)

history.note: Corrected semantics: hasValue requires the value among the property's values, not exclusively; fixed example title.
